notes: 0.10.0 remains the current published stable pre-1.0 release and remains immutable.

0.11.0rc1 promotes the feature-frozen known-truth simulation/recovery laboratory from qualified 0.11.0.dev0 without adding an estimator, numerical method, generalized family, hidden default, or post-0.11 research feature.
Stable 0.10.0 was reconciled into the 0.11 line through PR #109; 0.11.0.dev0 stabilization PR #110 passed the complete nine-workflow matrix and was merged to release/0.11-native-simulation.

Threshold-free stress evidence was added through PR #111. Exact post-merge stress run 36559953858 on commit f6bacfe64cd8639d365137f9c251b1c967aa78b5 executed all 14 declared stress regimes with three replicates each and retained failures in the denominator.

In that exact stress run, 13 of 14 regimes had zero execution failures. The estimated-noise diagonal-difference stress regime retained 2/3 fail-closed noise_variance_invalid fits; the one successful replicate showed strong subspace/score recovery but large measurement-noise relative error. No clipping or threshold widening was introduced.

The immutable 0.11.0.dev0 performance envelope is archived. Fresh 0.11.0rc1 performance qualification passed from source commit f37941710eba6e7d50806c60490d00492f98e1ff in GitHub Actions run 36560873074; canonical PERFORMANCE_ENVELOPE.json records that exact RC evidence.

Before publication, 0.11.0rc1 must pass the full pull-request matrix, exact release-branch/main qualification appropriate to the release ceremony, build/fresh-install checks, functional-simulation qualification, threshold-free stress execution, and release-readiness checks.
GitHub and production publication readiness remain deliberately disarmed during rc1 qualification. A separate reviewed arming change is required after exact-version qualification passes.

For 0.11.0rc1 and later release ceremonies, exact-main governance now requires the functional-simulation `recovery` check and threshold-free `stress-evidence` check in addition to the legacy package/docs/examples/optional-backend/performance/readiness checks.

Post-0.11 research remains deferred: package-wide recovery/external validation first, then native sparse multivariate FPCA, later sparse participant/trial decomposition, and signal-dependent observation/missingness as validation stress work.
